events.label: founding
events.text: Created as Audiencia of Los Confines of Guatemala and Nicaragua by royal decree.

evidence.quote: An Audiencia of Los Confines of Guatemala and Nicaragua was created by a royal decree of November 20 , 1542
The Audiencia was initially created by decrees of November 20 , 1542 and September 13 , 1543

events.label: territory
events.text: Establishment defined the kingdom's territory, most of Central America.

evidence.quote: In 1543 establishment of the Audiencia defined the territory of the kingdom , which included most of Central America

events.text: Decree ordered the Audiencia to move to Valladolid de Comayagua.

evidence.quote: The September 13 , 1543 , decree ordered that the new Audiencia move to Valladolid de Comayagua

events.text: Audiencia provisionally moved to Gracias a Dios.

evidence.quote: The Audiencia provisionally moved to Gracias a Dios on May 16 , 1544

events.text: Royal decree ordered the Audiencia's return to Santiago de Guatemala.

events.text: Royal decree reiterated separating Yucatán from Mexico into Guatemala's Audiencia.

evidence.quote: A royal decree of July 7 , 1550 , reiterated that Yucatán be separated

events.text: Decree transferred the province of Soconusco to the Guatemala Audiencia.

evidence.quote: Finally a decree of January 20 , 1553 , transferred the province of Soconusco to the Guatemala Audiencia

events.text: Philip II decreed the Audiencia move to Panama.

events.label: reestablishment
events.text: Decree reestablished the Audiencia of Guatemala with its 1563 jurisdiction, minus Yucatán.

evidence.quote: On January 15 , 1568 , a decree reestablished the Audiencia of Guatemala

events.text: Royal decree transferred Soconusco back from the Mexico Audiencia to Guatemala.
